mentions.note: Payment processing company; 'never seems to go out of fashion'; beneficiary of rotation to fintech and sustainable growth.
Announced aggressive 3-year growth targets at analyst day; real profitable business with $5B buyback authorized; best-performing S&P 500 stock, up 7.5%.

Rule of 40 guidance (growth + profitability) sent stock to best S&P 500 performer up 7.5%. Fundamentals disconnected from price: 30% CAGR since 2020, gross profit doubled; 2% penetrated in $500B market.
